# Cometux maintained package set.
#
# The auto-update workflow scans exactly these recipes instead of the
# upstream @all sweep: with BUILD_PACKAGES=true every bumped package is
# rebuilt in CI for verification, so an unbounded sweep over ~26000
# recipes risks blowing the 6h job limit. This list is the union of what
# the self-hosted apt repository already ships and the expansion set we
# intend to keep current.
#
# Names are recipe directory names, not binary package names — a
# subpackage (clang -> libllvm, bzip2 -> libbz2) has no recipe of its
# own and is rejected by the build workflow.
#
# Regenerate the "already shipping" part from the live repository:
#   curl -s <pages>/termux-main/dists/stable/main/binary-aarch64/Packages \
#     | grep '^Package:' | cut -d' ' -f2
# then map each binary package back to the recipe that produces it.
